text:
I'm sorry, that's frustrating. Here's where you stand:

- **Plant:** Losing about half its leaves is significant decline (more than a third), and you're at day 10 of the 30-day guarantee (90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member who ordered while active). Submit a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist reviews within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. If approved, you get one free replacement (store credit if out of stock). Note that repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered, so if you've done that, the claim may be affected.
- **Cracked pot:** The 48-hour window for reporting damaged items on arrival has passed, so I can't offer the DOA replacement or refund for it. The policy doesn't say whether the pot can be covered another way, so I can escalate that to a Support Lead if you'd like.

You can also get free care advice from a Plant Care Specialist by chat or email in the meantime.
